# Seattle Christmas Light Installers

> Professional Christmas and holiday light installation for homes in Seattle and the Eastside. Based in Kenmore, WA. Licensed, bonded and insured. Website: https://lightseattle.com

## Pricing
- Installs start at $800, with one flat price for the whole season
- New customers pay a 50% deposit to hold an install date. The balance is invoiced after the lights are up.

## What's included
- Commercial grade lights and equipment, leased for the season, so there is nothing to buy
- Warm white or any color, same price
- Free fixes all season if anything goes out
- Takedown included

## What we light
- Rooflines, gables and garages with C9 LED bulbs
- Wrapped trees and bushes
- Lit wreaths
- Every install comes with a timer

## How it works
- Get a free quote: fill out the form at https://lightseattle.com/#quote or call or text (425) 448-4998
- Most quotes are done from Google Maps or a photo and sent by text the same day
- Most homes are lit up within a week of booking. Nobody needs to be home.

## Contact
- Phone: (425) 448-4998
- Hours: call or text 7am to 7pm, every day
- Quote form: https://lightseattle.com/#quote
